answer_1.quote: Document summarization aims at producing a fluent, condensed summary for given documents... Our abstractive model gains an improvement...

answer_2.quote: We use ROUGE to evaluate the produced summary in our experiments.

answer_4.quote: To evaluate the linguistic quality of generated summaries, we carry out a human evaluation. We employ 5 graduate students to rate each summary.
answer_4.guideline: We focus on three aspects: fluency, informativeness, and non-redundancy.
